title: The Enum That Was Undefined: Naming a C++ Enum in QML, and the Integer It Accepted
fallback: This lesson is about an enum crossing into QML, so it needs Qt. Lesson 01-06 is about enums in plain C++ and the values that do not belong to one, and lesson 02-08 about turning a state into text. Without Qt, do those and come back when Qt is installed.

artifact.note: a robot mode that QML can name, with its names and values read from the meta object, an exact conversion from text and a check for a number that is not a mode
